but they give less when they measure or weigh for them.
Do they really not think that they will be resurrected
for a momentous Day,
a Day when people will stand before the Lord of the worlds?
No indeed! The record of the wicked is surely in Sijjīn.
How do you know what Sijjīn is?
It is a clearly inscribed Record.
Woe on that Day to the deniers,
those who deny the Judgment Day!
None denies it except every sinful transgressor.
When Our verses are recited to him, he says, “Ancient fables!”
No indeed! Their hearts have been stained by what they used to commit!
No indeed! On that Day they will be barred from seeing their Lord.
They will then surely enter the Blazing Fire,
then they will be told, “This is what you used to deny.”
No indeed! The record of the righteous is certainly in ‘illiyyīn –
and how do you know what ‘illiyyūn is? –
It is a record inscribed,
witnessed by those who are close to Allah.
Indeed, the righteous will be in Bliss,
seated on the couches, gazing in wonder.
You will see on their faces the radiance of bliss.
They will be served to drink pure wine from a sealed container,
whose last sip is musk – let those who strive, strive for that –
and it will be mixed with water from the spring of Tasnīm,
a spring from which those who are close to Allah will drink.
Indeed, the wicked used to laugh at the believers;
when they passed by them, they would wink at one another,
and when they went back to their people, they would return exulting.
When they saw the believers, they would say, “These people are truly misguided,”
although they were not sent as their keepers.
So Today the believers will laugh at the disbelievers,
while sitting on the couches, gazing around.
Have the disbelievers been rewarded except for what they used to do?
When the sky is rent asunder,
and hearkens to its Lord, as it must,
and when the earth is leveled out,
and casts out all what it contains, and becomes empty,
and hearkens to its Lord, as it must,
O humans, you are toiling towards your Lord, and you will surely meet Him.
Whoever is given his Record in his right hand,
he will have an easy reckoning,
and he will return to his people joyfully.
But whoever is given his Record from behind his back,
he will call out for destruction,
and he will enter the Blazing Fire.
Indeed, he used to live among his people joyfully.
and he thought that he would never return [to Allah].
Indeed he will! His Lord was always watching him.
Indeed, I swear by the twilight,
and by the night and what it covers,
and by the moon when it becomes full,
You will surely pass from one stage to another.
Then what is the matter with them that they do not believe,
and when the Qur’an is recited to them, they do not prostrate?
Rather, the disbelievers persist in denying it,
but Allah knows best whatever they harbor in their hearts.
So give them the tidings of a painful punishment.
But those who believe and do righteous deeds will have a never-ending reward.
By the sky full of constellations,
and by the promised Day,
and by the witness and the witnessed,
cursed be the makers of the trench,
the fire full of fuel,
when they sat around it,
and were witnessing what they did to the believers.
Their only grievance against them was that they believed in Allah, the All-Mighty, the Praiseworthy,
to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and earth, and Allah is Witness over all things.
Indeed, for those who tortured the believing men and women, and then did not repent, there will be the punishment of Hell and the punishment of the burning fire.
But those who believed and did righteous deeds will certainly have gardens under which rivers flow; that is the supreme triumph.
Indeed, the punishment of your Lord is severe.
Indeed, it is He Who originates [the creation] and then resurrects all,
and He is the All-Forgiving, the Most Affectionate,
the Lord of the Glorious Throne;
He does whatever He wills.
Has there not come to you the story of the forces
of Pharaoh and Thamūd?
But the disbelievers are in persistent denial,
although Allah encompasses them from all sides.
But this is a glorious Qur’an,
[inscribed] in a Preserved Tablet.
By the sky and the night comer –
and how do you know what the night comer is?
It is the star of piercing brightness –
there is no soul except that there is a watcher over it.
Let man reflect on what he was created from.
He was created from a spurting fluid,
emerging from between the backbone and the ribs.
Indeed, Allah is able to bring him back to life.
On the Day when all secrets will be disclosed,
he will then have no power, nor any helper.
By the sky and its recurring rain,
and by the earth that cracks open [with the sprout of plants],
Indeed, this [Qur’an] is a decisive word,
which is not for amusement.
Indeed, they are devising a plan.
I am too devising a plan.
So bear with the disbelievers, and give them respite for a while.
Glorify the name of your Lord, the Most High,
Who created and fashioned in due proportion,
and Who determined [the creation] then inspired them,
and Who brings forth the pasture,
then makes it into withered chaff.
We will teach you [the Qur’an], so you will not forget,
except what Allah wills, for indeed He knows what is manifest and what is hidden.
We will guide you to the easy way.
So remind, if the reminder should benefit.
He who fears Allah will take heed,
but the wretched will avoid it,
who will enter the Great Fire,
wherein he will neither die nor live.
Indeed, he who purifies himself will attain success,
and remembers his Lord’s Name and prays.
But you prefer the life of this world,
even though the Hereafter is better and more lasting.
Indeed, this was in the earlier Scriptures,
the Scriptures of Abraham and Moses.
Has there come to you the story of the Overwhelming Event?
On that Day, some faces will be humiliated,
overburdened and weary,
as they burn in a scorching Fire.
They will be made to drink from a boiling spring,
and they will have no food except bitter thorny plants,
that neither nourishes nor satisfies hunger.
Other faces on that Day will be joyful,
well-pleased with their past striving,
in an elevated garden,
wherein no idle talk will be heard.
There will be a flowing spring;
and couches raised high,
and cups placed ready,
and cushions lined up,
and splendid carpets spread out.
Do they not reflect on the camel, how it is created;
and the sky, how it is raised high;
and the mountains, how they are firmly set up;
and the earth, how it is spread out?
So remind [O Prophet]; your duty is only to remind;
you are not assigned to compel them.
But whoever turns away and disbelieves,
Allah will inflict upon him the greatest punishment.
Indeed, to Us is their return,
then it is for Us to call them to account.
By the dawn,
and the ten nights,
and the even and the odd,
and by the night when it comes,
are these oaths not sufficient for those who have sense?
Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with ‘Ād
of Iram, who were people of great stature,
the like of whom had never been created in the land;
and Thamūd, who carved out the rocks in the Valley;
and the mighty and powerful Pharaoh?
All of them transgressed in the land,
and spread therein much corruption,
so your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment.
Indeed, your Lord is ever vigilant.
As for man, when he is tested by his Lord by honoring him and bestowing blessings upon him, he says, “My Lord has [deservedly] honored me!”
But when he is tested by restricting his provision, he says, “My Lord has [undeservedly] humiliated me!”
No indeed! You are not kind to the orphan,
nor do you urge one another to feed the needy,
and you greedily consume the entire inheritance,
and love wealth immensely.
No indeed! When the earth is crushed over and over,
and your Lord comes with the angels, rank after rank,
and Hell is brought near on that Day – this is when man will understand, but what is the use of that understanding?
He will say, “Would that I had sent forth something for my [eternal] life!”
None can punish as He punishes on that Day,
and none can bind as He binds.
[It will be said to the believer,] “O the tranquil soul!
Return to your Lord, well pleased and pleasing [to Him].
Join My [righteous] slaves,
and enter My Paradise.”
I do swear by this city [of Makkah] –
and you are free of restriction [for a while] in this city –
and by every parent and his offspring,
We have created man in hardship.
Does he think that none can ever have power over him?
He says, “I have squandered enormous wealth!”
Does he think that no one sees him?
Have We not given him two eyes,
and a tongue and two lips,
and shown him the two ways [of right and wrong]?
Yet he did not make his way through the steep path,
and how do you know what the steep path is?
It is freeing a slave,
or giving food on a day of hunger,
to an orphan relative,
or to a needy person in misery,
then [most importantly] to be one of those who believe and exhort one another to patience and exhort one another to compassion.
Such are the people of the Right.
As for those who reject Our signs, they are the people of the Left,
who will be locked up in the Fire.
By the sun and its brightness,
and by the moon as it follows it,
